import json, math, random, re, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/solo/test4/task081")
import seqmodel

HERE = "/home/solo/test4/task081"
SEQ = os.path.join(HERE, "seqmodel.py")

def ref(model, corpus, window_text):
    vocab = model["vocab"]; V = len(vocab); H = len(model["h0"])
    W = model["W"]; b = model["b"]; Why = model["Why"]; by = model["by"]; h0 = model["h0"]
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", window_text)
    ids = [{ch:i for i,ch in enumerate(vocab)}[ch] for ch in corpus]
    cell = seqmodel.GRUCell(V, H)
    cell.W = [list(r) for r in W]; cell.b = list(b)
    h = list(h0); memory = [h0]; L = 0.0; T = len(ids)-1
    for t in range(T):
        y = ids[t+1]
        x = [0.0]*V; x[ids[t]] = 1.0
        h, _ = cell.forward(x, h)
        n = len(memory)
        lt = str(n)
        if len(window_text) > len(lt) or (len(window_text)==len(lt) and window_text>=lt):
            w = n
        else:
            w = int(window_text)
        M = list(memory[n-w:])
        c, _ = seqmodel.attention([h], M, M, None)
        u = [h[i]+c[0][i] for i in range(H)]
        z = []
        for k in range(V):
            acc = float(by[k])
            for j in range(H):
                acc += Why[k][j]*u[j]
            z.append(acc)
        m = max(z); d = 0.0
        for k in range(V):
            d += math.exp(z[k]-m)
        L += m + math.log(d) - z[y]
        memory.append([float(v) for v in h])
    return format(math.exp(L/T), ".17g") + "\n"

random.seed(123)
V, H = 3, 2
vocab = ["a","b","c"]
model = {
  "version": 3, "vocab": vocab,
  "W": [[random.uniform(-0.3,0.3) for _ in range(V+H)] for _ in range(3*H)],
  "b": [random.uniform(-0.1,0.1) for _ in range(3*H)],
  "Why": [[random.uniform(-0.5,0.5) for _ in range(H)] for _ in range(V)],
  "by": [0.0, 0.05, -0.02],
  "h0": [0.1, -0.1],
}
corpus = "abcabacabbacbabacab"

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
mp = os.path.join(tmp,"m.json"); cp = os.path.join(tmp,"c.txt")
open(mp,"w").write(json.dumps(model)+"\n")
open(cp,"w").write(corpus)

windows = ["1","2","3","5","100","9"*5000]
ok = True
for wn in windows:
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SEQ, "perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, wn],
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    expected = ref(model, corpus, wn).encode()
    match = (r.returncode==0 and r.stdout==expected and r.stderr==b"")
    ok &= match
    print("window", (wn[:10]+"...len%d"%len(wn)) if len(wn)>12 else wn,
          "rc",r.returncode,"match",match, r.stdout.decode().strip())

# determinism
r1 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SEQ, "perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "2"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
r2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SEQ, "perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "2"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("deterministic:", r1.stdout==r2.stdout)
ok &= (r1.stdout==r2.stdout)

# failure cases
def fail(args, label):
    global ok
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SEQ]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    good = r.returncode==2 and r.stdout==b"" and r.stderr==b"error\n"
    ok &= good
    print("fail-case", label, good)

fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "0"], "window 0")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "01"], "leading zero")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, ""], "empty window")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "1x"], "bad window")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, os.path.join(tmp,"nope"), "1"], "missing corpus")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", os.path.join(tmp,"nope"), cp, "1"], "missing model")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn"], "too few args")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp, "1", "extra"], "extra arg")
# wrong model version (version 2 LSTM model with c0 key ordering)
m2 = dict(model); 
lstm_model = {"version":2,"vocab":vocab,"W":model["W"],"b":model["b"],"Why":model["Why"],"by":model["by"],"h0":model["h0"],"c0":[0.0,0.0]}
mp2 = os.path.join(tmp,"m2.json"); open(mp2,"w").write(json.dumps(lstm_model))
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp2, cp, "1"], "version 2 rejected")
# OOV corpus
cp3 = os.path.join(tmp,"c3.txt"); open(cp3,"w").write("abz")
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp3, "1"], "OOV char")
# 1-codepoint corpus
cp4 = os.path.join(tmp,"c4.txt"); open(cp4,"wb").write("a".encode())
fail(["perplexity-gru-attn", mp, cp4, "1"], "single codepoint")
print("ALL OK" if ok else "FAILURES")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
